source_review.notes: Retrieved and reviewed the Starburst foundation; current Calcite algebra/adapter, PostgreSQL 18 expression, partition-pruning and FDW documentation; current Arrow Dataset, Parquet Bloom-filter, and DuckDB internals documentation; and the primary Dremel paper. Checked logical/source pushdown, residuals, planning/execution pruning, FDW outer-join rechecks, necessary filter columns, one-sided Bloom guarantees, sensitive metadata, and nested columnar execution.

evidence: Checked Req(v), Refs(e), exact/inexact pushdown, residual, barrier, pruning, selection vector, and false-positive/negative definitions.
Checked row, width, logical bytes, physical bytes, decode, transfer, and time remain different quantities.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Bindings, schema, bags/order, nulls, effects, policies, capabilities, and physical properties are explicit.

evidence: Recomputed 289-byte full and 25-byte required widths.
Recomputed 28.900 MB, 2.500 MB, 91.35% width opportunity, 2,000 survivors, and 98.00% row opportunity.
Recomputed 10,000 late-materialization survivors and illustrative payload volumes.
Reviewed monotone backward-demand fixed point and shared-subplan union.
Reviewed per-occurrence inner-join pushdown proof and matched/unmatched outer-join counterexample.
Reviewed conservative metadata, residual, position, security, and evidence invariants.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Eligibility proofs are separated from cost-based placement.

evidence: Reviewed empty/duplicate/null bags, multiple/unmatched joins, UNKNOWN, volatile/throwing expressions, correlation, aggregation, grouping sets, windows, limit, recursion, and shared plans.

Reviewed nested offsets/validity, deletes, sparse/dense selection, NaN/collation/truncated metadata, Bloom false positives, corruption, late dynamic filters, retries, cancellation, and capability drift.
Reviewed policies, masks, tenants, sensitive literals/metadata, remote principals, snapshots, and version mismatch.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Unknown or invalid pruning evidence falls back conservatively to scan and exact recheck.

evidence: Checked demanded output/local/hidden columns reach each scan.
Checked pushed predicates are binding-safe and exact or retain a conservative residual.
Checked metadata skips only proven-impossible regions and late materialization preserves row-position alignment.
invariant_checking.notes: Security dependencies and source semantic capability are part of correctness, not optional optimization metadata.

evidence: Reviewed operator demand equations and finite-set termination.
Reviewed inner/outer join, group-key, window/limit barrier, metadata-superset, and residual proofs.
Reviewed exactness versus conservative candidate generation.
proof_review.notes: No physical I/O or performance conclusion is derived from logical reduction alone.

evidence: The executable is labeled a logical opportunity model rather than a storage engine.
Product/version behavior is attributed to current official documentation.
Proof obligations, heuristics, cost choices, and empirical claims are labeled separately.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Source guarantees are treated as versioned contracts and evidence.

evidence: Repository verification passed one standard-library Python snippet with exact eleven-line stdout, empty stderr, zero exit status, and recorded Python 3.14.4 toolchain.
Independent recomputation reproduced width, volume, selectivity, and late-materialization arithmetic.
All eleven source artifacts were retained under artifacts/references/DBE-062 and local links were checked.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No live SQL/file/FDW query, physical-byte measurement, dynamic filter, metadata corruption, remote source, policy system, concurrency workload, or production canary was executed.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed backward demand, predicate decomposition/placement, operator barriers, sargability, pruning layers, conservative metadata, late materialization, federation/security, evidence, and operations.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed exact/inexact/unsupported capability states, residual enforcement, source/version contracts, privacy-safe counters, metadata integrity, planning/runtime budgets, canaries, result reconciliation, fallback, and kill switches.

pedagogical_review.notes: The chapter derives whole-plan analysis from first principles, executes an opportunity model, presents fourteen failure modes and ten distinct examples, and advances five exercises to a multitenant dynamic-filter/late-materialization release gate with complete answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, primary/official-source, mathematical, executable-snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external optimizer, SQL-semantics, storage-format, connector, security/privacy, distributed-systems, reliability, or educator review is claimed. The chapter and finite model prove neither full SQL equivalence, correctness of a production rule/reader/connector, metadata integrity, remote semantic compatibility, physical I/O savings, representative performance, policy compliance, certification, nor deployment fitness.
